notes: Summary: Neon Snare builds an IDE copilot focused on test-driven feedback and pre-commit linting. Looking for a sandboxed function-calling runtime to run testers/linters as functions invoked by the model.
Primary ask: low-latency streaming + secure function/tool calling to run ephemeral test runners inside an isolated sandbox. Must demonstrate no exfil of code or secrets.
"They need model pinning — deterministic assistant behavior for CI checks (cannot drift between commits)." — Head of ML (quote from 2026-02-02 call)
Latency target: median token latency <60ms end-to-end inside IDE sessions; cold start for tool-run <500ms. Throughput: concurrent 120 dev sessions during peak builds.
Cost sensitivity: medium — willing to commit if unit economics for dedicated pools are proven. Interested in Optimize recommendations for batching and KV caching.
Sandbox constraints: no persistent outbound network from build/test runners; allowed artifacts must be pushed to a controlled S3 bucket in their VPC. Prefer Private or Dedicated with VPC peering.
Security: require SSO/SAML, enterprise audit logs, HSM-backed KMS for keys, ISO27001 evidence. Also need retention controls (30/90/365 day options) and ability to purge POC artifacts post-test.

POC scope proposed: 2-week sandbox in Private (customer VPC) with function-calling that launches containerized linters/test runners in ephemeral namespaces. Success metrics: proof of no-evidence-of-exfil, latency targets met, CC/QA pass rate >=95%.

Technical notes: prefer model family that supports efficient KV cache reuse for interactive completions; will test small- and medium-sized pinned model variants. Need tooling to pin versions and rollback quickly.
